_comment: Everything this unit creates in Unity Catalog and the raw volume. The study app shows it on the unit's start page, checks each against Unity Catalog, and the cleanup_unit job removes exactly these. setup: made by the unit's set-up job. lesson/assignment: made as the learner works. optional: does not count towards the unit being worked through. transient: the notebook removes it itself; listed so clean-up catches leftovers. A name ending in * matches every table with that prefix. tools/tests/test_unit_resources.py fails when a notebook creates something this file does not name.
